business_summary: System D Inc. develops and sells industry specific package software products in Japan. The company offers Campus plan, a solution that supports school operations; School Engine, a cloud-based system for school affairs; PPP public accounting system, a local government accounting package software; Public Asset Management, a system for the management of local government assets; Common, a financial accounting system for local governments; and Smart Hello, a solution to support operations at amusement parks, zoos, and other tourist attractions. It also provides soft engineering services and solutions, including regulation management, and contract creation and management systems. The company was formerly known as Gendai Kobosha Co., Ltd. and changed its name to System D Inc. in June 1984. System D Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
